description: This file contains an example script for an interactive graphical demonstration, featuring a slider control, visualization of mathematical functions (abs, map, constrain, dist), and drawing shapes and lines based on user interaction.

methods.name: slider
methods.description: Draws a slider with a line and circle to represent a value between x1 and x2 at a given y-coordinate. Visualizes the slider's position based on the 'value' parameter.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the graphical window of size 600x600.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Main rendering loop that updates the background, displays text labels, graphical elements, and interactive sliders based on mouse input.
